name: Soccer Stars 26
creator: picon studio
redeem: Open Soccer Stars 26 on Roblox and wait for the lobby to load.
Tap the CODE button, which has a Discord logo on it.
Paste a code into the ENTER CODE box with no extra spaces.
Press the green CLAIM button to get your Cash.
notes:
Soccer Stars 26 is a street soccer game from picon studio, released on Roblox in June 2026. Matches are fast five-minute games on a small futsal pitch, with AI goalkeepers guarding both nets. You sprint, dribble, spin, pass, slide tackle and charge up power shots, and score and assist leaderboards let you compare yourself with other players.

The codes so far give Cash, and one of them also adds a Profile Card Crate. Cash is what you spend in the game, so these codes help you unlock things sooner. There are only a couple of codes right now. The game's page says free Cash codes are shared in its Discord, so new ones will most likely show up there with updates and player milestones.

codes.reward: 500 Cash and a Profile Card Crate

faq.q: Which Soccer Stars 26 code gives the most Cash?
faq.a: WELCOME101 gives 1,000 Cash. FRIEND2026 gives 500 Cash plus a Profile Card Crate, so it is worth claiming both.

faq.q: Where is the code button in Soccer Stars 26?
faq.a: Look for the CODE button with the Discord logo on the main screen. Tapping it opens the ENTER CODE box and the green CLAIM button.

faq.q: Where do new Soccer Stars 26 codes come from?
faq.a: The developers share free Cash codes in their Discord server, which you can join from the link on the game's Roblox page.
